{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient contributes only once
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that deduplication worked: should now have 800 unique patient_id values
print(f"Number of unique patient_id after deduplication: {deduplicated_data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows after deduplication: {len(deduplicated_data)}")

# Check assay_batch distribution in deduplicated data
print("\nAssay batch distribution after deduplication:")
print(deduplicated_data['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
